# Step - out

`out` · category: [Walking the graph](../../traversal/step_reference.md#walking-the-graph)

Moves to the adjacent vertices over outgoing edges, optionally only edges with the given labels.

## Forms

```text
out()
out(arg1: any)
out(arg1: array)
out(arg1: any, arg2: any)
out(arg1, …, arg10)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).out("knows").values("name").to_list()   // ["josh", "vadas"]
```
